title: Homotopy morphisms into a termwise injective complex are exact
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. Let $0\to A^\bullet\to B^\bullet\to C^\bullet\to0$ be a short exact sequence of cochain complexes (cochain complexes and their morphisms are as in [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]) in $\mathcal A$, and let $I^\bullet$ be a cochain complex whose every term is injective [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Then the sequence of abelian groups $\operatorname{Hom}_{K(\mathcal A)}(C^\bullet,I^\bullet)\to\operatorname{Hom}_{K(\mathcal A)}(B^\bullet,I^\bullet)\to\operatorname{Hom}_{K(\mathcal A)}(A^\bullet,I^\bullet)$ is exact at the middle group.

source.place: Lemma lemma-characterize-K-injective, proof at the successor step (the displayed exact sequence after the short exact sequence of complexes)

proof.text: For each integer $n$, form the degree-$n$ Hom-cochain groups $\operatorname{Hom}^n(X^\bullet,I^\bullet)=\prod_p\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(X^p,I^{p+n})$ for $X=A,B,C$, with differential $df=d_I\circ f-(-1)^nf\circ d_X$. Precomposition with $A^p\to B^p\to C^p$ gives, for each $p$ and $n$, a sequence $0\to\operatorname{Hom}(C^p,I^{p+n})\to\operatorname{Hom}(B^p,I^{p+n})\to\operatorname{Hom}(A^p,I^{p+n})\to0$ which is exact: injectivity on the left because $B^p\to C^p$ is an epimorphism; exactness in the middle because a map $B^p\to I^{p+n}$ vanishing on $A^p$ factors through the cokernel $C^p$; surjectivity on the right because $A^p\to B^p$ is a monomorphism and $I^{p+n}$ is injective [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. A product of short exact sequences of abelian groups is short exact, and precomposition with chain maps commutes with the Hom-complex differentials, so $0\to\operatorname{Hom}^\bullet(C^\bullet,I^\bullet)\to\operatorname{Hom}^\bullet(B^\bullet,I^\bullet)\to\operatorname{Hom}^\bullet(A^\bullet,I^\bullet)\to0$ is a short exact sequence of cochain complexes of abelian groups.

source.place: Lemma lemma-characterize-K-injective, successor step: exactness of the Hom complexes

proof.text: Apply the long exact cohomology sequence for this short exact sequence of cochain complexes [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-homology-long-exact]. Its exactness at degree-zero cohomology gives an exact sequence from $H^0\operatorname{Hom}^\bullet(C^\bullet,I^\bullet)$ to $H^0\operatorname{Hom}^\bullet(B^\bullet,I^\bullet)$ to $H^0\operatorname{Hom}^\bullet(A^\bullet,I^\bullet)$.

source.place: Lemma lemma-characterize-K-injective, successor step: the displayed exact Hom sequence

proof.text: Two morphisms of complexes $f,g:X^\bullet\to I^\bullet$ are homotopic if $f^p-g^p=d_I^{p-1}h^p+h^{p+1}d_X^p$ for some $h^p:X^p\to I^{p-1}$, and $\operatorname{Hom}_{K(\mathcal A)}$ is the group of morphisms of complexes modulo homotopy [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. By the formula for the Hom-complex differential, degree-zero cocycles are exactly the morphisms of complexes and degree-zero coboundaries $d h$ are exactly the null-homotopic maps. Therefore $H^0\operatorname{Hom}^\bullet(X^\bullet,I^\bullet)=\operatorname{Hom}_{K(\mathcal A)}(X^\bullet,I^\bullet)$ for $X=A,B,C$, compatibly with precomposition, and the exact sequence of Step 2 is the claimed exact sequence in the homotopy category.
